    Quiver representations as modules over the linearization of a path category #

    For a finite acyclic quiver Q, a representation N of Q gives a module ⊕ᵥ N(v) over k(PathCat Q) on which a path p : a → b acts by N(p) from the a-component to the b-component (RayCat.RepTot). This is a fully faithful functor (RayCat.repFunctor), so representation-finiteness of k(PathCat Q) gives finite representation type of Q in the sense of LargeIndecomposable (RayCat.isFiniteRepType_of_isRepresentationFinite).
